html:
/* Template:NewsFeed/styles.css  -  layout of the News page and of the header on the article pages.
   The colours (card background, title, text) live in MediaWiki:Citizen.css (the News block), they change with the light/dark theme. */
.aa-news {
  display: block;
}
/* the two big cards: they run edge to edge over the panel (the panel has 24px / 28px padding) */
.aa-news-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: -24px -28px 12px;
}
.aa-news-hero > .aa-news-card {
  height: 100%;
  border-width: 1px;
  border-radius: 17px;
}
.aa-news-cols {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: start;
  margin: 0 -28px;
}
.aa-news-col {
  min-width: 0;
}
@media (max-width: 999px) {
  .aa-news-hero { margin: 0 0 20px; }
  .aa-news-cols { margin: 0; }
}
.aa-news-coltitle {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #5a4d44;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.aa-news-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  grid-auto-rows: 272px;
  gap: 12px;
}
/* every small card has the same height: the title is cut after 2 lines, the summary after 3 */
.aa-news-grid .aa-news-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
}
.aa-news-grid .aa-news-pic {
  flex: none;
}
.aa-news-grid .aa-news-body {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-news-card {
  position: relative;
  border-width: 1px;
  border-style: solid;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;
}
.aa-news-pic {
  display: block;
  height: 120px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-news-pic a,
.aa-news-pic span,
.aa-news-pic .mw-file-element {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.aa-news-pic img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: 50% 25%;
}
.aa-news-noimg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3a3330, #6a5d48); }
.aa-news-noimg-update { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d3a55, #3b6f9c); }
.aa-news-noimg-announcement { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5a2f17, #e28552); }
.aa-news-noimg-marketplace { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3d2a55, #8a63b8); }
.aa-news-body {
  padding: 10px 12px 12px;
}
.aa-news-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.aa-news-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(150, 140, 130, .18);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.aa-news-tag-update { background: rgba(90, 170, 232, .16); color: #4f9ad8; }
.aa-news-tag-announcement { background: rgba(226, 133, 82, .18); color: #d9743b; }
.aa-news-tag-marketplace { background: rgba(160, 120, 210, .18); color: #9a6fd0; }
.aa-news-title {
  display: block;
  max-height: 2.6em;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.aa-news-body > a::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
}
.aa-news-sum {
  margin-top: 4px;
  max-height: 4.2em;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.aa-news-feat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.aa-news-feat .aa-news-pic {
  position: relative;
  flex: none;
  height: 280px;
}
.aa-news-feat .aa-news-pic::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 0 auto 0;
  height: 110px;
  background: linear-gradient(rgba(10, 7, 5, .8), rgba(10, 7, 5, 0));
  pointer-events: none;
}
.aa-news-herolabel {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  left: 24px;
  z-index: 2;
  color: #f6e9dc;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 34px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .7);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.aa-news-feat .aa-news-body {
  flex: 1;
}
.aa-news-feat .aa-news-sum {
  max-height: 5.6em;
}
.aa-news-feat .aa-news-title {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.aa-news-feat .aa-news-body {
  padding: 14px 16px 16px;
}
.aa-news-feat .aa-news-sum {
  font-size: 14px;
}
.aa-news-more {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.aa-news-archive {
  margin-top: 18px;
  text-align: right;
}
.aa-news-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .aa-news-hero,
  .aa-news-cols {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .aa-news-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Article header (banner, title, summary) */
.aa-newsart { margin: 0 0 18px; }
.aa-newsart-banner { margin: -24px -28px 14px; border-radius: 17px 17px 0 0; overflow: hidden; line-height: 0; }
@media (max-width: 999px) {
  .aa-newsart-banner { margin: 0 0 14px; border-radius: 12px; }
}
.aa-newsart-banner img { width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 340px; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; display: block; }
.aa-newsart-top { padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(226, 133, 82, .18); }
.aa-newsart-title { font-size: 1.9em; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; margin: 6px 0 8px; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; }
.aa-newsart-sum { font-size: 1.05em; line-height: 1.55; opacity: .85; }
